resources.string: Kaasu reads on-screen transaction-history text from the UPI/banking apps enabled below (currently Google Pay and PhonePe) — only while you have one of them open, and only their transaction-list screens — to catch payments its other capture methods missed, such as a dismissed notification or an in-app-only balance change. It does NOT read PIN or password entry screens, does NOT tap, type, or navigate anything on your behalf, and nothing it reads is ever sent anywhere — it stays on this device, same as every other part of Kaasu.
